name: PhotoPrism
description: Photo library with face recognition, maps and search

paths.name: Storage
paths.description: The index database, thumbnails, sidecar files, settings and this install's admin password (.icestore-photoprism-admin-password). Back it up.

paths.name: Originals
paths.description: Your photos and videos: /mnt/cache/gallery on your MOS. PhotoPrism indexes them and puts uploads here.

paths.name: Import
paths.description: Drop files here to import them into originals, sorted by date.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: PhotoPrism web app, WebDAV and API, published on host as 6858

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: PHOTOPRISM_ADMIN_USER
variables.description: The admin user made on first start. The password is shown in the app's logs, in the box marked CREDENTIALS.

variables.name: PHOTOPRISM_SITE_URL
variables.description: The address you open PhotoPrism at, used in share links: replace YOUR-SERVER-IP with your server IP, like http://192.168.1.20:6858/.

variables.name: PHOTOPRISM_DATABASE_DRIVER
variables.description: sqlite keeps the index in a file in the storage folder. Use mysql with your own MariaDB for big libraries.
